svg.title: Swimlane: P6 Scraper (system actor)
svg.desc: 6 numbered steps of Scraper (system actor) left to right across 1 system lanes; each card shows its trigger, page, action, data written and hand-off, with dashed fallback cards below.

g.aria-label: P6 step 1 on Worker: songnodes.schedule enqueues tick:scrape_targets:{hour}. Trigger: 30s beat. Writes: ingestion_jobs scrape_targets. Fallback: bucket collision skips duplicates.
g.title: P6 step 1 on Worker: songnodes.schedule enqueues tick:scrape_targets:{hour}. Trigger: 30s beat. Writes: ingestion_jobs scrape_targets. Fallback: bucket collision skips duplicates.

g.title: Fallback branch of step 1

g.aria-label: Fallback for step 1: bucket collision skips duplicates
g.title: Fallback for step 1: bucket collision skips duplicates

g.aria-label: P6 step 2 on Worker: scrape_targets picks 2 active targets older than 7 days (SKIP LOCKED), one scrape job per source. Trigger: job run. Writes: target_tracks.last_searched, ingestion_jobs scrape. Fallback: outside_window returns without work.
g.title: P6 step 2 on Worker: scrape_targets picks 2 active targets older than 7 days (SKIP LOCKED), one scrape job per source. Trigger: job run. Writes: target_tracks.last_searched, ingestion_jobs scrape. Fallback: outside_window returns without work.

g.aria-label: Fallback branch of step 2
g.title: Fallback branch of step 2

g.aria-label: Fallback for step 2: outside_window returns without work
g.title: Fallback for step 2: outside_window returns without work

g.aria-label: P6 step 3 on Worker: claim scrape (lease 1800s) and POST /scrape. Trigger: drain. Writes: ingestion_jobs running. Hands off ScrapeRequest json via sn-be-http-worker-to-scraper. Fallback: transport error or 5xx/429 -> retry with backoff.
g.title: P6 step 3 on Worker: claim scrape (lease 1800s) and POST /scrape. Trigger: drain. Writes: ingestion_jobs running. Hands off ScrapeRequest json via sn-be-http-worker-to-scraper. Fallback: transport error or 5xx/429 -> retry with backoff.

g.aria-label: Fallback branch of step 3
g.title: Fallback branch of step 3

g.aria-label: Fallback for step 3: transport error or 5xx/429 -> retry with backoff
g.title: Fallback for step 3: transport error or 5xx/429 -> retry with backoff

g.aria-label: P6 step 4 on Unified scraper: scrapy crawl subprocess; item pipelines persist. Trigger: POST /scrape. Writes: bronze_*, silver_*, Redis quota and dedupe keys. Fallback: daily_quota_reached closes the spider with nothing found; 900s timeout -> 504.
g.title: P6 step 4 on Unified scraper: scrapy crawl subprocess; item pipelines persist. Trigger: POST /scrape. Writes: bronze_*, silver_*, Redis quota and dedupe keys. Fallback: daily_quota_reached closes the spider with nothing found; 900s timeout -> 504.

g.aria-label: Fallback branch of step 4
g.title: Fallback branch of step 4

g.aria-label: Fallback for step 4: daily_quota_reached closes the spider with nothing found; 900s timeout -> 504
g.title: Fallback for step 4: daily_quota_reached closes the spider with nothing found; 900s timeout -> 504

g.aria-label: P6 step 5 on Worker: record playlists_found, complete job, enqueue ingest_pending. Trigger: scraper response. Writes: target_tracks.playlists_found, ingestion_jobs. Hands off follow-up job ingest-after-scrape:{job_id} via sn-be-sql-ingestion-jobs. Fallback: 60s ingest tick.
g.title: P6 step 5 on Worker: record playlists_found, complete job, enqueue ingest_pending. Trigger: scraper response. Writes: target_tracks.playlists_found, ingestion_jobs. Hands off follow-up job ingest-after-scrape:{job_id} via sn-be-sql-ingestion-jobs. Fallback: 60s ingest tick.

g.title: Fallback branch of step 5

g.aria-label: Fallback for step 5: 60s ingest tick
g.title: Fallback for step 5: 60s ingest tick

g.aria-label: P6 step 6 on Worker: ingest_pending builds silver and N -> N+1 transitions. Trigger: follow-up. Writes: silver_*, silver_track_transitions, outbox. Hands off silver_track_transitions via sn-be-sql-graph-read-silver. Fallback: rejected playlist outbox event.
g.title: P6 step 6 on Worker: ingest_pending builds silver and N -> N+1 transitions. Trigger: follow-up. Writes: silver_*, silver_track_transitions, outbox. Hands off silver_track_transitions via sn-be-sql-graph-read-silver. Fallback: rejected playlist outbox event.
